videos.description: Union High School unveiled its new costumed mascot, Rocket the Redhawk, during a pep assembly Tuesday morning at the Union Multipurpose Activity Center. Approximately 3,500 high school students gathered for Rocket’s debut, marking the final step in the district’s transition to the Redhawks mascot. The change began in 2021 when the district retired its previous mascot. Students selected Redhawks as the new mascot, and the logo design, created by 11th grader Caiden Morales, was approved in 2022. To name the costumed mascot, students were invited to submit suggestions, with Rocket emerging as the favorite. #oklahoma #news #highscoolsports #newmascot
